observations.summary: Saudi state media citing an energy ministry source reported a strike in the Medina region, a limited extinguished fire, no casualties, and no disruption to pipeline operations. This is a retrospective discovery of an event reported before the preceding scan, not proof of a new attack during this scan.
observations.title: Saudi energy ministry reports strike on East-West oil pipeline

observations.summary: French officials released a joint cyber-agency attribution report, summoned Iran's ambassador and threatened further EU sanctions. The underlying sabotage occurred in October; the new development is the November 9 official attribution and diplomatic response, not a newly observed cyberattack. Reuters reported French claims; attribution is not independently established by this report.
observations.title: France publicly attributes October refrigeration cyber sabotage to Iranian-linked unit
